label: Figure 3.6: The demand for bicycles (a movement)
alt: A downward-sloping demand curve for bicycles with prices p and p1 and quantities q and q1 marked, showing a movement along the curve.
caption: A fall in the price of bicycles from p to p<sub>1</sub> causes a movement along the existing demand curve D, an increase in quantity demanded from q to q<sub>1</sub>. The curve itself does not shift.
